decision_question: Can the unchanged three-candidate method produce 100 complete source-linked clusters when isolated non-completed provider batches are quarantined rather than terminating all valid evidence?

method.method_change: Retain three-candidate blind validation, reduce each batch from four to three clusters, quarantine isolated non-identity provider failures, and reject every affected cluster without weakening selected-package truth.
method.boundary_authority: Versioned deterministic policy templates own all abstain, clarify, and refuse cases.
method.deterministic_authority: Only candidates with exact source-span and action recovery, unambiguous natural wording, no leakage, unique wording, valid lineage, and complete cluster coverage can enter the selected package.
method.quarantine_policy: Incomplete, malformed, refused, or schema-invalid model batches remain durable failed calls and make their affected clusters ineligible; identity, credential, binding, request, call-limit, or cost drift remains globally terminal.

prospective_rationale.attempt_005_result: Thirty-two calls completed before author batch 17 returned a non-completed OpenAI response; this was operational, not a reference-quality result.
prospective_rationale.finite_operational_correction: Smaller batches and per-batch quarantine preserve valid completed evidence while rejecting affected clusters from the 60-cluster reserve.
